name: Submit Password Change and Reject
summary: An authenticated user submits a password-change request that the credential service rejects; the existing password remains active and the password-change surface presents an actionable error.

preconditions.description: The current durable identity is authenticated and has an existing password credential.

serverInteraction.intent: Attempt to replace the current authenticated user's password credential and return the credential-service rejection without modifying the existing credential.

postconditions.expression: identity.passwordCredentialReplaced == false && identity.unchanged == true && session.authenticated == true
postconditions.description: The current password credential remains unchanged and the user stays authenticated as the same durable identity.

sourceReferences.note: ChangePasswordAsync records ChangePasswordFailed when ASP.NET Identity rejects the credential replacement attempt.
Existing presentation model establishes current password, new password, and confirm password as the user inputs.
Canonical flow binding maps the rejected submit to the normalized server implementation and failure transition.
Integration proof executes the real flow entry point, handler, PasswordManager and LagoVista Identity adapter before the mocked Microsoft Identity boundary rejects the change.

Wrong-current-password and new-password-policy rejection are evidence permutations beneath this canonical rejected submit scenario rather than sequential scenarios. Client-only confirmation mismatch is presentation validation and does not represent a server credential-change attempt.
